items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I know one time we did a broadcast with -- is his name Orson Welles?

ctx.x: They'd reach out and get Guy Lombardo and anybody but the soul brothers never got it. You'd better believe it, baby. You ask me, I'll tell you. Because I revert back to what I say, I was there. I was behind the Cotton Curtain. I was behind the Cotton Curtain. That's what we called it. I was there.
I know one time we did a broadcast with -- is his name Orson Welles?
